steps.message:

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

results.content:
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Orders are fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepts at most 60 lines per order.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
Raised for customers who need larger orders (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md).
# Support inquiries about the cart limit (2026-08)
40 inquiries from customers who could not add more than 60 items.
Requested cart sizes: median 80, largest 100.
The customers who wrote in buy the same product mix as customers overall.
# Fulfilment contract with Northwind Logistics (summary)
Term: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-31.
Section 4: each order sent to Northwind may contain at most 60 lines.
# Fulfilment
Since 2025-11-01 orders are fulfilled from our own warehouse.
The Northwind contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed.
Our warehouse system has no limit on lines per order.

steps.reasoning_content: The 60-line limit came from the Northwind contract, which expired on 2025-10-31, while our own warehouse has no such limit. The config and design doc already say 100, so I'm updating the outdated ADR and logging the decision.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/cart-max-items.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: "max_items.default: 100"
status: final
evidence: [docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, docs/ops/fulfilment.md, docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
The repository held two values: 60 (ADR 0007) and 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md). The 60 existed because one cart becomes one order and the Northwind Logistics contract (section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed; since 2025-11-01 our own warehouse fulfils orders and has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md). The 100 was set after 40 support inquiries from customers blocked at 60, with a largest requested size of 100, and those customers resemble customers overall. The grounds for 60 are gone and the grounds for 100 remain, so 100 is adopted and ADR 0007 is updated to match.
EOF
cat > docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Superseded (2026-11-01) - see docs/decisions/cart-max-items.md
## Context
Orders were fulfilled by Northwind Logistics, and one cart becomes one order. The contract (docs/contracts/northwind-fulfilment.md, section 4) accepted at most 60 lines per order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31; orders are now fulfilled from our own warehouse, which has no line limit (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).
## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items (originally 60, while the Northwind limit applied).
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: align cart item limit on 100, record decision

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 100 everywhere, and I committed the change as `00e4eaa` on master. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

- **Why 60 existed:** ADR 0007 set it because the Northwind Logistics contract accepted at most 60 lines per order, and one cart becomes one order. That contract ended on 2025-10-31.
- **Why 100 wins:** Since 2025-11-01 our own warehouse fulfils orders and has no line limit. The raise to 100 followed 40 support inquiries from customers blocked at 60, whose largest request was 100.
- **What changed:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, so I left them alone. I updated `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` to say 100 and marked it superseded.
- **Decision record:** `docs/decisions/cart-max-items.md` holds the decision (`max_items.default: 100`) and the evidence files behind it.
